2.  **Assignment:** For each camera position $X$, assign it to the cluster $C_j$ whose centroid $O_j$ is closest to $X$ [S1].

The claim states that for each camera position X, it is assigned to the cluster C_j whose centroid O_j is closest to X. The evidence explicitly defines the objective of the K-Means clustering as minimizing the total within-cluster squared error E = sum ||X - O_i||^2_2. In the context of K-Means clustering, minimizing this error function is mathematically equivalent to assigning each data point (camera position X) to the cluster with the nearest centroid (O_j). The evidence also confirms that the method uses K-Means clustering on 3D camera positions to partition the data.
